fee_notes: License Fee: 5–7% of gross sales (excluding specialty services and roll-in sales) with minimum fees per Fees Chart (not fully detailed in excerpt). MAP Fee: 2% of gross sales. Local Marketing Groups: up to 3% of gross sales (currently ~2% allocated to Neighborly initiatives). Software includes ServiceTitan, Qvinci, FranConnect, Neighborly Portal, Microsoft Office 365. Additional Microsoft email accounts $5.50–$30/month; portal users $20–$40/month. Support at $125/hour. QuickBooks Online $30–$220/month (tier-dependent). HelpDesk Plus: $400/month for 6 hours plus $75/hour overage. Fees subject to increase, projected max 30% annually.
